paper_title: Predicting transcriptional outcomes of novel multigene perturbations with GEARS

split.note: Hold out unseen 2-gene combinations; single perturbations seen during training

preprocess.note: Total-count normalization to 1e4, then log1p; top 5000 HVGs selected

metrics.name: pearson_de
metrics.note: Pearson correlation on top-20 differentially expressed genes vs ctrl

metrics.name: pearson
metrics.note: Pearson correlation across all genes (mean over test perturbations)

reported_values._note: Approximate — verify against Table 1 of paper (Nature Biotechnology 2024). Value is for double perturbations on Norman2019.

notes: GEARS uses a graph neural network over a gene-gene interaction graph (from STRING + GO). Key detail: the HVG count (5000) is higher than many other models (2000). Using 2000 HVG will likely reduce pearson_de.
